ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) distribution across approximately 90-95% of the visible surface area, with sparse, high-intensity (white) pixel clusters and streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity linear streaks clustered in the lower-left quadrant; high-intensity irregular textured clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; isolated circular high-intensity rings located on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation with a sharp vertex and symmetrical divergent lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel-amplitude variations near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve along the trailing edges transitioning into a sharp upward convex sweep at the terminal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast, textured pixel blobs at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization; discrete white circular rings on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, multi-directional linear high-intensity streaks (rake marks) localized on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified-texture accumulation and irregular surface topography at the extreme left and right fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct high-contrast white ring-shaped markings (approximate 15-pixel diameter) on the upper-right fluke lobe.
